actions.name: Pack Warden rations
actions.description: Pay the Ashgate stores to seal four route-ready provision packs.
actions.tradeoff: More travel flexibility now, but six fewer ashmarks for cargo.

actions.name: Join the cistern queue
actions.description: Wait with the wellkeepers to learn which pumps are failing.
actions.tradeoff: Better local information in exchange for a day.
actions.unavailable_reason: Cistern reports are not connected to the simulation yet.

actions.name: Reserve the repair bench
actions.description: Set aside foundry time for caravan repairs.
actions.tradeoff: Future protection in exchange for money and one day.
actions.unavailable_reason: Caravan condition is not implemented yet.

actions.name: Buy a route rumor
actions.description: Pay a broker for a recent route report of uncertain quality.
actions.tradeoff: Potentially useful information that never guarantees safety.
actions.unavailable_reason: Information confidence is not implemented yet.

actions.name: Open the supply shelter
actions.description: Reserve delivered goods for a protected local supply point.
actions.tradeoff: Sacrifice immediate margin to strengthen a future market.
actions.unavailable_reason: The shelter requires the relief-contract system.

records.name: Reedwatch Water Relief
records.description: Carry four sealed water units from Ashgate to Reedwatch before the public reserve is rationed.
records.tradeoff: A guaranteed premium and visible relief, but four hold spaces and a short deadline are committed.
records.failure_recovery: Late cargo remains yours to sell, and the penalty never takes more ashmarks than you hold.

records.title: The Gatekeeper's Chalk
records.setup: An Ash Warden clerk marks the caravan wheels with fresh chalk and disputes the posted passage rate.
records.stakes: Pay for certainty, spend time and provisions on an exposed detour, or wait for a stamped review.

choices.label: Pay 6 ashmarks
choices.outcome: The clerk clears the chalk and records the caravan's passage.

choices.label: Take the dust detour
choices.outcome: The caravan avoids the gate but spends another day and provision on exposed ground.

choices.label: Wait for stamped review
choices.outcome: The office confirms the original fare after a full day of delay.

records.title: The Span at Cinderford
records.setup: A Cinderford bridge crew has shored up a failed support and recognizes repair stock in the caravan.
records.stakes: Trade the material for immediate margin, reserve it for a safer public span, carry the measurements onward, or turn back with the load intact.

choices.label: Sell 2 repair materials for 30 ashmarks
choices.outcome: The crew buys the stock for private repair work; the public span remains exposed.

choices.label: Reserve 2 materials for the public span

route_condition.label: Cinderford span patched
route_condition.description: Reserved repair stock has lowered the chance of a load failure at the Cinderford span.

choices.outcome: The crew bolts the reserved stock into the public support and reopens a steadier crossing.

choices.label: Carry the repair measurements onward

route_condition.label: Cinderford span surveyed
route_condition.description: Delivered measurements let the road crews mark a safer load line across the span.

choices.outcome: The next road crew receives exact measurements and marks a safer load line.

choices.label: Turn back with the cargo intact
choices.outcome: The caravan reverses before the failed support and preserves the full load.

records.title: The Last Clean Barrel
records.setup: The destination's public water queue is down to its last sealed barrel when the caravan reaches the ration line.
records.stakes: Take the scarcity premium, strengthen the public queue, honor a relief commitment, or keep the load for an ordinary market sale.

choices.label: Sell 2 water at the emergency premium
choices.outcome: Private buyers take the sealed barrels at the posted emergency premium.

choices.label: Share 2 water through the public queue
choices.outcome: The queue stewards ration both barrels and add the caravan's name to the public reserve ledger.

choices.label: Keep the load for the relief commitment
choices.outcome: The queue stands aside while the caravan reports directly to the named contract sponsor.

choices.label: Keep the barrels sealed for the market
choices.outcome: The caravan keeps control of the load and enters the ordinary market.

records.title: Three Riders, No Banner
records.setup: Three unmarked riders match the caravan's pace and offer to guarantee the exposed crossing for a price.
records.stakes: Buy certainty, risk one disclosed cargo unit, trade medicine for passage, or wait long enough to identify their sponsor mark.

choices.label: Pay 10 ashmarks for escort
choices.outcome: The riders form a close screen around the caravan until the destination markers appear.

choices.label: Refuse and cross alone
choices.outcome: The caravan keeps its money and accepts the disclosed exposed-unit risk.

choices.label: Trade 1 medicine for passage
choices.outcome: One rider pockets the sealed medicine and leads the caravan through a screened cut.

choices.label: Wait and read the riders' tracks
choices.outcome: At dusk the riders leave; their tack has pressed a repeated sponsor mark into the ash.

old_road.name: Old Road
old_road.description: Cheap, exposed, and watched by opportunists.

toll_road.name: Toll Road
toll_road.description: Expensive but maintained by the Ash Wardens.

dry_cut.name: Dry Cut
dry_cut.description: Fast on the map, punishing on provisions.
